Trans-1,2-dichloroethylene C2H2Cl2 (CAS156-60-5) contains no fluorine and is absent from 2024/590 Annex I and II (not dichloromethane CH2Cl2 or tetrachloroethene C2Cl4). No Article21 periodic ODS check applies to this component. 2024/573 Annex VI page59 assigns default0 to unlisted non-fluorinated mixture components. This is a regulatory default, not a measured zero GWP or zero ODP.
